```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- 第一步：读取计算结果 ---
# 这里确保变量名与你之前的 DR 代码块一致
imp_data <- readRDS("stars_mice_mids.rds")      # 读入 mids 对象
stars1_wide <- readRDS("stars1_wide_final.rds") # 读入原始宽表（含 stayed_g3）

# --- 第二步：数据准备 (衔接你接下来的代码) ---
# 提取第 1 次插补的结果
completed_data <- complete(imp_data, 1)

# 定义需要还原 NA 的成绩列
math_cols <- c("math_score_K", "math_score_1", "math_score_2", "math_score_3")

# 执行还原与合并（这就是你代码中开始处理的地方）
stars_dr_prepared <- completed_data %>%
  mutate(
    student_id = stars1_wide$student_id,
    stayed_g3  = stars1_wide$stayed_g3
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(math_cols), ~ stars1_wide[[cur_column()]]))
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# 优化方案：循环处理 20 个插补集并汇总 DR 结果
# ====================================================================

m <- imp_data$m  # 假设插补次数为 20
dr_results_list <- list()

for (i in 1:m) {
  # 1. 提取第 i 个插补集
  current_data <- complete(imp_data, i)
  
  # 2. 还原结果变量 NA (保持与原始缺失模式一致)
  current_prepared <- current_data %>%
    mutate(
      student_id = stars1_wide$student_id,
      stayed_g3  = stars1_wide$stayed_g3
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(math_cols), ~ stars1_wide[[cur_column()]]))
  
  # 3. 拟合缺失模型 (PS Model)
  ps_fit <- glm(stayed_g3 ~ student_race + student_gender + birth_year + 
                free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
                data = current_prepared, family = binomial)
  pi_hat <- predict(ps_fit, type = "response")
  
  # 4. 拟合结果模型 (Outcome Model) - 仅用观测值
  out_fit <- lm(math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + 
                free_lunch_3 + area_type_3 + teacher_degree_3, 
                data = subset(current_prepared, stayed_g3 == 1))
  m_hat <- predict(out_fit, newdata = current_prepared)
  
  # 5. 计算 AIPW Pseudo-outcome
  y_obs <- current_prepared$math_score_3
  r_ind <- current_prepared$stayed_g3
  
  # AIPW 公式实现
  dr_pseudo <- m_hat + (r_ind / pi_hat) * (replace_na(y_obs, 0) - m_hat)
  
  # 6. 对当前这个“平行世界”运行最终效应模型
  current_res_model <- lm(dr_pseudo ~ class_type_3 + student_race + free_lunch_3, 
                          data = current_prepared)
  
  dr_results_list[[i]] <- current_res_model
}

# 7. 使用 Rubin's Rules 汇总 20 个模型的结果
library(mice)
mira_obj <- as.mira(dr_results_list)
final_pooled_dr <- pool(mira_obj)

# 查看最精准的、汇总后的因果效应
summary(final_pooled_dr)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 5: Missingness Model (The IPW Basis)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 拟合逻辑回归模型
# 我们使用 MICE 填补好的完整协变量来预测 'stayed_g3' (即 Ri)
miss_model <- glm(
  stayed_g3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + birth_year + 
              free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
  data = stars_dr_prepared, 
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

# 2. 计算倾向得分 pi_hat
stars_dr_prepared <- stars_dr_prepared %>%
  mutate(pi_hat = predict(miss_model, type = "response"))

# --- 快速检查 ---
cat("检查点 3a: 倾向得分 (pi_hat) 摘要\n")
print(summary(stars_dr_prepared$pi_hat))

# 检查 Positivity Assumption: 是否所有 pi_hat 都严格大于 0 且小于 1？
cat("\n检查点 3b: 是否存在极端的权重 (Positivity Check)?\n")
# 如果有值非常接近 0 (例如 < 0.01)，则需要注意
print(range(stars_dr_prepared$pi_hat))
```

```{r}
# 使用 lapply 对 20 个数据集分别计算倾向得分
ps_list <- lapply(1:20, function(i) {
  # 1. 提取第 i 个插补集
  d <- complete(imp_data, i)
  
  # 2. 【核心修复】显式注入 stayed_g3 变量
  # 确保是从含有该变量的原始宽表 stars1_wide 中获取
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      stayed_g3 = stars1_wide$stayed_g3
    )
  
  # 3. 拟合模型
  fit <- glm(stayed_g3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + 
             free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
             data = d, family = binomial)
             
  return(predict(fit, type = "response"))
})
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 6: Outcome Model & DR Estimation (The Grand Finale)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 拟合结果模型 (Outcome Model)
# 我们只在观测到 Y3 的样本上训练。
# 变量选择：使用 MICE 填好的 100% 完整变量，确保“共轭性” (Congeniality)
outcome_model <- lm(
  math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + 
                 free_lunch_3 + area_type_3 + teacher_degree_3, 
  data = subset(stars_dr_prepared, stayed_g3 == 1)
)

# 2. 生成预测值 m_hat (针对全体样本)
# 因为自变量在第四步后都是完整的，所以这里不会产生任何新的 NA
stars_dr_prepared$m_hat <- predict(outcome_model, newdata = stars_dr_prepared)

# 3. 执行 AIPW (Doubly Robust) 计算公式
# 根据 Seaman (2018)，公式为：E[m_hat + R/pi_hat * (Y - m_hat)]
stars_dr_final <- stars_dr_prepared %>%
  mutate(
    # 计算误差修正项：如果是缺失值(R=0)，修正项为 0；如果是观测值(R=1)，进行逆概率加权
    dr_correction = ifelse(stayed_g3 == 1, 
                           (1 / pi_hat) * (math_score_3 - m_hat), 
                           0),
    # 每一位学生的 DR 贡献值
    dr_pseudo_outcome = m_hat + dr_correction
  )

# 4. 汇总结果：得到全校范围内的无偏均值估计
final_summary <- stars_dr_final %>%
  summarize(
    DR_Mean = mean(dr_pseudo_outcome),
    Observed_Mean = mean(math_score_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sample_Size = n()
  )

# --- 快速检查 ---
cat("检查点 4: 最终 DR 估计 vs 原始观测均值\n")
print(final_summary)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# 修正后的 20 次循环 DR (AIPW) 计算逻辑
# ====================================================================

m <- imp_data$m  # 20 次插补
dr_estimates <- sapply(1:m, function(i) {
  
  # 1. 提取第 i 个插补集
  d <- complete(imp_data, i)
  
  # 2. 【核心修复】重新注入流失指标和 ID
  # 确保是从含有该变量的原始宽表 stars1_wide 中获取
  d$stayed_g3 <- stars1_wide$stayed_g3
  d$student_id <- stars1_wide$student_id
  
  # 3. 拟合缺失模型 (PS Model) 以获取该数据集下的 pi_hat
  # 注意：在 20 个不同数据集中，pi_hat 会有细微差别，这正是 MI 的意义
  ps_fit <- glm(stayed_g3 ~ student_race + student_gender + free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
                data = d, family = binomial)
  pi_hat <- predict(ps_fit, type = "response")
  
  # 4. 拟合结果模型 (Outcome Model) 
  # 只在观测到三年级成绩的学生中训练
  out_fit <- lm(math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + 
                free_lunch_3 + area_type_3 + teacher_degree_3, 
                data = subset(d, stayed_g3 == 1))
  
  # 5. 生成对全体样本的预测值 m_hat
  m_hat <- predict(out_fit, newdata = d)
  
  # 6. 计算 AIPW (Double Robust) 估计量
  # 我们需要原始的有 NA 的成绩
  y_obs <- stars1_wide$math_score_3
  r_ind <- d$stayed_g3
  
  # AIPW 公式实现：E[m_hat + R/pi_hat * (Y - m_hat)]
  # replace_na 用于处理 R=0 时的计算，因为 R=0 时修正项会被乘 0，所以填什么不重要
  dr_pseudo_val <- m_hat + (r_ind / pi_hat) * (ifelse(is.na(y_obs), 0, y_obs) - m_hat)
  
  # 返回该平行世界的平均均值
  return(mean(dr_pseudo_val))
})

# 最终经过 20 次汇总后的 DR 均值
final_dr_mean <- mean(dr_estimates)

# 计算插补间方差以评估不确定性
dr_se <- sd(dr_estimates) / sqrt(m)

cat("最终 20 次汇总后的 DR 估计均值:", final_dr_mean, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================

# ====================================================================

# 1. 对比不同班级类型在 DR 修正后的得分
final_effect <- stars_dr_final %>%
  group_by(class_type_3) %>%
  summarize(
    DR_Adjusted_Mean = mean(dr_pseudo_outcome),
    Observed_Mean = mean(math_score_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    # 偏差修正量：负值表示该组流失了较多差生
    Bias_Correction = DR_Adjusted_Mean - Observed_Mean 
  )

summary(final_model)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 7: 构建用于 ANOVA 的长表 (集成 DR 修正值)
# ====================================================================

# 1. 提取 K, 1, 2 年级的原始观测数据 (以及背景协变量)
stars_long_base <- stars1_wide %>%
  select(student_id, 
         # 选择我们要分析的成绩和班级类型
         math_score_K, math_score_1, math_score_2,
         class_type_K, class_type_1, class_type_2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -student_id,
    # 正则表达式：(变量名)_(年级后缀)
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(K|1|2)", 
    names_to = c(".value", "grade_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(grade = case_when(
    grade_label == "K" ~ "Grade 0",
    grade_label == "1" ~ "Grade 1",
    grade_label == "2" ~ "Grade 2"
  )) %>%
  select(-grade_label)

# 2. 准备 Year 3 的 DR 修正数据
# 注意：列名必须与上面的 math_score 和 class_type 完全一致
stars_g3_dr <- stars_dr_final %>%
  select(student_id, class_type_3, dr_pseudo_outcome) %>%
  rename(math_score = dr_pseudo_outcome, 
         class_type = class_type_3) %>%
  mutate(grade = "Grade 3")

# 3. 合并
stars_long_final <- bind_rows(stars_long_base, stars_g3_dr) %>%
  mutate(
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("Grade 0", "Grade 1", "Grade 2", "Grade 3")),
    class_type = factor(class_type)
  ) %>%
  # 剔除那些在特定年级没有班级记录的学生行（可选）
  filter(!is.na(class_type))

# --- 验证数据结构 ---
cat("检查点 6: 最终长表结构\n")
str(stars_long_final)
# 预期：11601 * 4 = 46404 行左右，列只有 student_id, math_score, class_type, grade
```

```{r}
  complete(student_id, grade) %>%
```

```{r}
# 定义三种不同复杂度的结果模型
specs <- list(
  "Minimal"  = math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race,

# 循环计算不同模型下的 DR Mean
sensitivity_results <- lapply(specs, function(formula) {
  m <- lm(formula, data = subset(stars_dr_prepared, stayed_g3 == 1))
  m_hat <- predict(m, newdata = stars_dr_prepared)
  # 使用之前算好的 pi_hat
  dr_pseudo <- m_hat + ifelse(stars_dr_prepared$stayed_g3 == 1, 
                              (1/stars_dr_prepared$pi_hat)*(stars_dr_prepared$math_score_3 - m_hat), 0)
  mean(dr_pseudo)
})
```

```{r}
# 对权重进行修剪 (Trimming)
stars_dr_final <- stars_dr_final %>%
  mutate(weight = 1/pi_hat,
         # 将极端的权重限制在 5% 到 95% 分位数之间
         trimmed_weight = pmin(pmax(weight, quantile(weight, 0.05)), quantile(weight, 0.95)))

# 计算修剪后的均值

                     ifelse(stars_dr_final$stayed_g3 == 1, 
                            stars_dr_final$trimmed_weight * (stars_dr_final$math_score_3 - stars_dr_final$m_hat), 0))
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# 完整方案：20个插补集循环处理、DR计算与ANOVA汇总
# ====================================================================
library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

m <- imp_data$m  # 自动获取插补次数，通常为 20
anova_models_list <- list()

for (i in 1:m) {
  # 1. 提取第 i 个插补集并注入必要变量
  d <- complete(imp_data, i)
  d$stayed_g3 <- stars1_wide$stayed_g3
  d$student_id <- stars1_wide$student_id
  
  # 2. 拟合缺失模型 (Propensity Score Model)
  # 使用当前数据集的完整协变量预测留存概率
  ps_fit <- glm(stayed_g3 ~ student_race + student_gender + birth_year + 
                free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
                data = d, family = binomial)
  d$pi_hat <- predict(ps_fit, type = "response")
  
  # 3. 拟合结果模型 (Outcome Model)
  # 仅在观测到三年级成绩的学生中训练
  out_fit <- lm(math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 + student_race + student_gender + 
                free_lunch_3 + area_type_3 + teacher_degree_3, 
                data = subset(d, stayed_g3 == 1))
  d$m_hat <- predict(out_fit, newdata = d)
  
  # 4. 计算 AIPW Pseudo-outcome (dr_pseudo_val)
  # 公式：E[m_hat + R/pi_hat * (Y - m_hat)]
  y_obs <- stars1_wide$math_score_3
  r_ind <- d$stayed_g3
  
  # 计算每一位学生的 DR 贡献值（处理缺失值的关键步骤）
  d$dr_pseudo_val <- d$m_hat + (r_ind / d$pi_hat) * (ifelse(is.na(y_obs), 0, y_obs) - d$m_hat)
  
  # 5. 构建 ANOVA 所需的长表
  # A. K-2 年级原始观测数据
  base_long <- stars1_wide %>%
    select(student_id, math_score_K, math_score_1, math_score_2, 
           class_type_K, class_type_1, class_type_2) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -student_id, 
                 names_pattern = "(.*)_(K|1|2)", 
                 names_to = c(".value", "grade_label")) %>%
    mutate(grade = case_when(
      grade_label == "K" ~ "Grade 0",
      grade_label == "1" ~ "Grade 1",
      grade_label == "2" ~ "Grade 2"
    )) %>%
    select(-grade_label)
  
  # B. Grade 3 DR 修正数据 (来自当前插补集 d)
  g3_dr <- d %>%
    select(student_id, class_type_3, dr_pseudo_val) %>%
    rename(math_score = dr_pseudo_val, 
           class_type = class_type_3) %>%
    mutate(grade = "Grade 3")
  
  # C. 合并并补齐 class_type (确保 longitudinal 结构完整)
  current_long <- bind_rows(base_long, g3_dr) %>%
    mutate(grade = factor(grade, levels = c("Grade 0", "Grade 1", "Grade 2", "Grade 3"))) %>%
    group_by(student_id) %>%
    fill(class_type, .direction = "downup") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(class_type))
  
  # 6. 拟合当前平行世界的线性模型
  # 我们使用 lm 以便后续通过 pool() 进行 Rubin's Rules 汇总
  anova_models_list[[i]] <- lm(math_score ~ class_type * grade, data = current_long)
}

# 7. 汇总 20 个世界的结果 (Rubin's Rules)
mira_anova <- as.mira(anova_models_list)
pooled_anova <- pool(mira_anova)

# --- 最终输出 ---
cat("\n--- 20次插补汇总后的双因素分析结果 ---\n")
print(summary(pooled_anova, conf.int = TRUE))
```

```{r}
ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = Grade, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.2, size = 1, color = "#2c3e50") +
  labs(title = "Causal Effect of Small Class Size Across Grades",
       subtitle = "Grade 3 effect is Doubly Robust adjusted",
       y = "Score Advantage (Small vs. Regular)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Using the density plot provided by mice, it will draw the original data (blue) and 20 imputed versions (thin red lines).

```{r}
# 展示所有 20 个插补版本的分布，红色细线越多且越集中，说明插补越稳定
densityplot(imp_data, ~ math_score_3, 
            main = "Distribution Across 20 Imputations",
            xlab = "Math Score (Grade 3)")
```

Extract the summarized means and confidence intervals from pooled_anova.

```{r}
# 1. 从汇总模型中提取效应量
eff_summary <- summary(pooled_anova, conf.int = TRUE)

# 2. 筛选出我们要展示的项 (例如各个年级下小班的效应)
# 这里手动构建绘图数据，数据来源于 summary(pooled_anova)
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Grade = c("K", "G1", "G2", "G3 (DR)"),
  Estimate = c(7.94, 11.36, 8.40, 7.54), # 这些值需替换为汇总后的 summary 结果
  StdErr = c(2.10, 2.05, 2.15, 1.85)     # 替换为 summary 里的 std.error
)

# 3. 绘制带有汇总误差棒的 Forest Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Grade, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Estimate - 1.96*StdErr, ymax = Estimate + 1.96*StdErr), 
                width = 0.2, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Pooled Causal Effect of Small Class (m=20)",
       subtitle = "Error bars represent 95% CI including between-imputation variance",
       y = "Score Advantage", x = "Grade Level") +
  theme_minimal()
```

To demonstrate the robustness of IPW, plot the overlapping distribution of propensity scores in 20 parallel worlds.

```{r}
# 假设 ps_list 存储了 20 组概率
ps_df <- data.frame(ps = unlist(ps_list), 
                    imp = rep(1:20, each = length(ps_list[[1]])))

ggplot(ps_df, aes(x = ps, group = imp)) +
  geom_density(color = "red", alpha = 0.1) +
  labs(title = "Propensity Score Overlap across 20 Imputations",
       x = "Estimated Pr(Stayed in G3)", y = "Density") +
  theme_light()
```
